title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin closed the US session at 64,609 dollars, up 3.5 percent, showing clear buyer strength despite extreme fear at 25. The move came on steady hashrate above 1,000 EH/s and a loaded mempool of 100,000-plus transactions with fees bottoming at 2 sat per vbyte. Low fees point to accessible on-chain demand even as broader sentiment stays depressed. Takeaway: price is holding structure while fear readings flag potential capitulation.
